pin.title: Enter your PIN
pin.lead: The 5-character code you were given. You only need it once on this device.
pin.help: Letters or numbers. Capital or small doesn't matter.
pin.link: Got a link? Opening it fills this in for you.
share.waiting.one: 1 file you shared is waiting for the PIN.
share.waiting.other: {n} files you shared are waiting for the PIN.
share.failed: The shared files didn't come along. Choose them here instead.
pin.wrong.one: That PIN didn't work. 1 try left.
pin.wrong.other: That PIN didn't work. {n} tries left.
pin.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {time}.
pin.ended: This PIN doesn't work any more. Ask for a new one.
pin.sessionEnded: The PIN you used has ended. Enter a new PIN to finish sending.
pin.sessionLost: This browser lost your PIN. Enter it again to finish sending.
pin.noCookie: This browser didn't keep your PIN. Allow cookies for this site and try again.
pin.network: The server can't be reached. Check your internet and try again.
ready.title: Send your files
ready.lead: Photos, videos, documents, anything. Everything arrives unchanged, in full quality.
ready.leadDay: Photos, videos, documents, anything. No app, no account.
drop.title: Drop files or folders here
ready.tip: Tip: use Wi-Fi for big batches. If the page closes, open it again and it carries on.
ready.private: Others with this PIN can't see what you send.
sending.title: Sending your files…
sending.keepOpen: Keep this page open. Switching apps for a moment is fine, it picks up where it stopped.
sending.keepOpenDesktop: Keep this tab open. You can work in other windows meanwhile.
welcome.title: Welcome back
welcome.lead: Your last upload was interrupted. Nothing is lost.
ghosts.videos.one: 1 video needs to be picked again
ghosts.videos.other: {n} videos need to be picked again
ghosts.files.one: 1 file needs to be picked again
ghosts.files.other: {n} files need to be picked again
ghosts.why.one: This browser didn't keep this big file. Pick the same one again and it goes on from where it stopped.
ghosts.why.other: This browser didn't keep these big files. Pick the same {n} again and they go on from where they stopped.
done.title: All done, thank you!
done.lead: Your files arrived safely, in full quality.
done.close: You can close this page now.
install.title: Add {name} to your home screen
install.lead: Next time it opens like an app.
install.leadDesktop: Next time it opens in its own window.
join.lead: To see and download the shared files, install the {name} app first. It takes a minute.
join.step2Detail: Your phone may ask you to allow this once, and warn that the app isn't from the Play Store. That's expected.
join.scanStep: Scan the code with your Android phone
join.scanStepDetail: Its camera opens this invite on the phone.
join.installStepDetail: It takes a minute; the page on the phone shows how.
join.scan: Scan this with your Android phone
join.tabletDownload: On an Android tablet? Download the app here ({size})
join.used: It was used already; each invite works once. Ask for a new one.
join.expired: It has expired. Ask for a new one.
join.unknown: The link isn't complete. Open it again from the message you got.
join.locked: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and open the link again.
join.leadBoth: See and download the shared files in the {name} app on your Android phone, or right here in this browser.
join.useBrowserNote: Signs this browser in as {person}, no password needed. The invite then can't be used on the phone.
join.browserLead: This browser will be signed in as {person}. No password needed.
join.roleAdmin: Admin: also delete files, and manage PINs and people
join.notYouInviter: Not {person}? Stop here and ask {inviter} for your own invite.
join.notYou: Not {person}? Stop here and ask for your own invite.
join.noCookie: This browser keeps no cookies, and signing in needs them. Allow cookies for this site and open the link again.
join.cookieLost: This browser didn't keep the sign-in, and the invite is used up now. Allow cookies for this site and ask for a new invite.
